objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and linked in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Includes the document type abbreviation, a consecutive 4-digit number per type, and the title by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Part of the document name after abbreviation and number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Maintained metadata that can be printed in the document; documents pass through workflow statuses.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Maintained metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity period is calculated.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from the Valid From date and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose change affects distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version that must be released before translation can be carried out.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document; document types can be changed or added and can have templates, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a validity check is necessary for the document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type before physical deletion of archived documents.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created when a released document is revised or when reactivation is confirmed; released versions retain documented signatures.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document and managed without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a document to invalidate and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved in document management as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator, or workflow participant.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned authorizations, distribution, archive access, or roles.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow status, tasks, release, change proposals, validity extension, override, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in the system.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in the system.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in the system.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in the system.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Reader, user, or role-specific view filled using distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons and users in assigned user groups for a released document version.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-specific version of a released document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the document templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current converted document version on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Change the content of a document after release or during editing.

evts.name: change_document_property
evts.description: Change document properties after release or during editing.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process in the Control (release) category.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark released attachments for archiving.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: Start the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves release of the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject the document during review or release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature or acknowledgement workflow task without signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual workflow participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is revised or when certain changes occur.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: inform_document_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation.

evts.name: print_change_proposal
evts.description: Print change proposals in a document for information purposes.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: Send an e-mail notification to the creator of a proposal after editing is documented.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Manage change proposals in the document cockpit.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity for a document.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after validity is extended or a new revised version is released.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a new revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for Override for a document.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Start the workflow for processing a request for AKS automatically after attaching the request.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and their attachments invalid.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents and their attachments by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke authorizations at user group and person level for archived documents.

evts.name: delete_document_physically
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Start the reactivation workflow automatically after creating the request.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation of an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for a document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail from persons and users of assigned user groups upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of the current document version.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all maintained persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents using role-specific reports and searches with selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check a translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release a translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_document_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to an existing document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Documents managed in versions have versions.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with a version of the main document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for Override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning user groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
User groups can be assigned read authorization and distribution for documents.
Persons can be assigned author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, and distribution responsibilities for documents.
Users are in user groups.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
Workflow tasks are assigned to involved users.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with other documents, and local documents can reference original documents.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
Acknowledgements are confirmations for a document and are summarized for authors or key roles.
Documents can have language versions for translated released content.
Dashboards list or assign documents relevant to users.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
